headline: Loss widens year over year
summary_short: Johnan Academic Preparatory Institute posted a Q2 FY2026 EPS loss of ¥21.85, widening 14.6% y/y from a ¥19.07 loss.
summary_long: The per-share loss of ¥21.85 widened 14.6% year-over-year from a ¥19.07 loss, and swung from a ¥8.14 profit in the prior quarter. This is the only KPI carried on the shard for this period; no revenue, margin, or balance-sheet figures are available from the wire feed.
confidence_notes: KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed.
